description: Optimize the geometry of a carbon monoxide molecule.
user_prompt: Optimize the geometry of a carbon monoxide molecule, then report the final energy and C-O bond length.

method.modeling: Gas-phase CO molecule in a cubic box with at least 12 Angstrom vacuum separation.
method.rationale: The target C-O bond length is the PAW/PBE value reported by Han (2022) for VASP molecular geometries. The reference uses a 600 eV cutoff and a 23 x 22 x 21 Angstrom molecular cell. Only the bond length is scored because the absolute molecular total energy is sensitive to PAW dataset and cell conventions. The +/-0.02 Angstrom tolerance covers ordinary PAW/PBE setup and relaxation-threshold differences.
